name: When should I call a professional general contractor for sliding door rot?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional general contractor for sliding door rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should contact a professional general contractor when you suspect or confirm rot damage around your sliding door, especially if the rot appears extensive, has compromised the structural integrity of the door frame or surrounding wall, or if you're unsure of the cause. A contractor can accurately assess the damage, identify the source of moisture, determine whether repair or replacement is needed, and ensure all necessary repairs, including framing and waterproofing, are completed to code and industry standards, preventing recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional when rot is extensive, affects structural integrity, or you need help identifying the cause and ensuring proper, lasting repairs.
